# swe-diagrams

> Open-source CLI and agent skill that draws diagrams of software. A coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor writes 10 to 30 short lines in the `.sd` language, and the program draws the diagram in about 3 milliseconds. Each part can show a status: done, in progress, planned, added, changed, or removed.

- Twelve diagram types: `arch`, `seq`, `plan`, `deps`, `flow`, `state`, `dataflow`, `change`, `erd`, `class`, `timeline`, and `journey`.
- Outputs: SVG (light and dark theme), interactive HTML, PNG, GIF, MP4, WebM, and terminal text. The extension of the output file sets the format.
- Render: `swe-diagrams render diagram.sd -o diagram.svg`. Add `--animate` for motion without a script.
- Install: tell the agent "Install swe-diagrams for me. Follow the steps in https://github.com/Benny-Gil/swe-diagrams/blob/main/docs/install.md". Or run `npx swe-diagrams`, `cargo install swe-diagrams`, or the install script for macOS and Linux.
- License: MIT. Current version: 0.2.0.

Example source:

```
arch "Checkout"
user "Shopper" :actor
web "Next.js" "app router" @nextjs done
api "Hono" "http api" @hono wip
db "Neon" "postgres" :store @neon add
user => web => api => db
```

- [Full text for language models](https://swe-diagrams.bennygil.me/llms-full.txt): the README, the install steps, the agent skill, and the language reference in one file
